title: TutorialCore: Integrations
summary: Let tutorials react to manuals, missions, records, scans, and real player milestones.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: Wiki guide books report progress when opened. Terminal, HoloMap, Lens, PowerGrid, WorldCore, and MissionCore all publish player actions that can guide help.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use TutorialCore with Wiki guide opens, Terminal notices, HoloMap use, Lens scans, PowerGrid alerts, WorldCore hazards, and route-specific player actions.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: If a hook is absent, the card should still teach the next action in plain terms. Good tutorial text survives without automation.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
